i.norm: When stripLeading=true and the input contains only whitespace, every character is classified as "leading whitespace" and skipped, so the accumulator (accum) is never written to. Passing null for accum is therefore safe: the null reference is never dereferenced and no NullPointerException is thrown.
10 spaces — every character will be stripped as leading whitespace
Should complete without throwing, because accum is never accessed when all content is stripped
